text:
Google acquired Wiz to close its security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, betting that cloud-security consolidation would be the next battleground in the "cloud wars" driven by AI-driven cloud adoption [Source: ev-1]. The deal signaled this strategic shift toward cloud-security as a primary competitive arena.

It was announced on March 18, 2025, as an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $32 billion, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1]. The final price reflected negotiations following Wiz’s rejection of Google’s earlier offer of $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
